tasks.label: Cline: review workspace
tasks.command:
pwd && ls -la && echo '
---' && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort | sed 's#^\./##' | head -200

tasks.label: Cline: install dependencies
tasks.command: if [ -f package.json ]; then npm install; else echo 'No package.json found in this workspace yet.'; fi

tasks.label: Cline: run project
tasks.command: if [ -f package.json ]; then npm run dev || npm start; else echo 'No runnable app configured yet.'; fi
